artifacts.name: leonidas_catalogue.pdf
artifacts.desc: Professional A4 product catalogue generated from the Leonidas NCOM Excel file — 1191 articles, 28 familles, 2 gammes (Permanente & Saisonnière), with cover page, table of contents, and per-article table (Code CHC, Réf. fournisseur, Désignation, Dimensions, Colisage) in the Leonidas navy/gold palette.

versions.note: Full catalogue PDF generated from leonidas_catalogue.xlsx — cover, TOC, all categories/families/sub-families, alternating-row tables, paginated with gold/navy header and footer. Single-pass build, no iterations needed.

artifacts.name: build_catalogue.py
artifacts.desc: Python script using openpyxl + ReportLab to parse the 5-column Leonidas NCOM Excel catalogue and render a multi-section A4 PDF with custom page templates, numbered canvas, TOC, and branded colour palette.

versions.note: Complete build script — loads data, defines styles, page templates (cover + content), TOC builder, product table builder, category/family/sub-family banners, NumberedCanvas for page numbering. Outputs to /mnt/user-data/outputs/.
